name: effect-frost-melt
title: Frost Melt Unlock
description: Lớp băng mờ có bông tuyết phủ thẻ tan dần từ mép vào giữa với mép tan lởm chởm, để lộ nội dung đã mở khoá bên dưới; ổ khoá ở giữa là chỗ tan sau cùng.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-material-frost-melt, written here): Frost layer over a card 160x100 r12 (grey-blue fill, 16 seeded six-arm snowflakes, a LOCKED icon). Its round mask (radius 112 → 0, vertical × 0.78, edge noise ±16 % drifting slowly) shrinks from the edges to the centre over 1.65 s power1.inOut (0.45-2.1 s) with a thin light rim (1.5 px, 70 %) on the melting edge; the unlocked content (accent lock, UNLOCKED) shows beneath; the lock is the last thing covered. The frost returns by a fade 3.3-3.8 s. Params: melt (1.65 s, power1.inOut) · radius (112 → 0) · roughness (±16 %) · aspect (0.78) · refreeze (fade 0.5 s). The frost's mask shrinks from radius 112 to 0 over 1.65 s (power1.inOut), so the lock in the middle is the last thing covered; the frost comes back by a fade.
